goal: Move small, reusable static helpers out of the enum (mergeAttributes, isWhitespace, HandleTextState, and nullString) into a focused utility class to reduce the enum's method footprint and improve cohesion.

ops.details: Create a new utility class HtmlTreeBuilderStateUtil in org.jsoup.parser. This class will host static helper methods and constants moved from the enum: mergeAttributes(Token.StartTag, Element), isWhitespace(Token), HandleTextState(Token.StartTag, HtmlTreeBuilder, TokeniserState), and the nullString constant. Preserve signatures and visibility appropriate for calls from HtmlTreeBuilderState (use public static methods).

Move the implementations verbatim to HtmlTreeBuilderStateUtil as public static methods/fields. Adjust any references inside moved methods to other types to be fully qualified or imported in the new class. Ensure Token.StartTag, Element, TokeniserState and other types used are imported. Preserve behavior exactly.

Replace internal calls to mergeAttributes(...), isWhitespace(...), HandleTextState(...) and references to nullString in HtmlTreeBuilderState with calls to HtmlTreeBuilderStateUtil.mergeAttributes(...), HtmlTreeBuilderStateUtil.isWhitespace(...), HtmlTreeBuilderStateUtil.HandleTextState(...), and HtmlTreeBuilderStateUtil.nullString respectively (or add a static import if preferred).

Update related tests affected by this refactoring block so the configured build command passes. Adjust imports, package references, moved class references, constructors, and assertions only when required. Do not change production behavior through tests.
